note: append-only: an id is never reused for different numbers; content_sha256 pins each entry

frame_definitions.rel_obj: hand (end-effector body) position minus object origin, in the object's yaw-only frame Rz(object_yaw) (world z up), metres
frame_definitions.hand_yaw_rel_deg: yaw about world z of the demonstration hand relative to the executor's yaw-aligned grasp quaternion q0 = Rz(wrap_pi/4(object_yaw)) * q_down (q_down = the reset-pose end-effector quaternion)
frame_definitions.hand_quat_obj_xyzw: full hand orientation in the object's yaw-only frame: Rz(object_yaw)^-1 * R_hand, xyzw, w >= 0 (absent: the executor uses a vertical hand, yaw only)
